# PyO3 macros divergence

PyO3 0.30.1 from the `v0.30.1` release (`f168538672f2c32e32f7c1b702a502ee92de1edf`). No source patch applies to this crate; its macro backend is linked to the sibling vendored crate, and its normalized manifest excludes Cargo's reserved source metadata files. Remove this copy when the owning PyO3 release is adopted.
